rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a thorough job analyzing the build failures, correctly identifying the root cause as net472 incompatibility with .NET Core-only APIs in HotReload test files. It distinguished between the primary errors and cascading errors, identified the multi-targeting configuration, and noted the separate net10.0 issues. The analysis is well-structured and actionable with a clear fix recommendation. Minor gaps include not specifically naming MetadataUpdater/AssemblyLoadContext as the key missing hot-reload symbols, instead focusing on other .NET Core APIs like System.Text.Json and ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList.
